title: Multiplying by 10, 100, 1,000 … 1,000,000
description: Discover the secret trick: multiplying by 10, 100, 1,000 and more just adds zeros to the end!
intro: First, add up 10 bubbles and watch what happens to the number. 3 × 10 = 30 — that's 3 with a 0 on the end!
100 is 10 × 10, so it has 2 zeros. 1,000 has 3 zeros. 1,000,000 has 6 zeros!
To multiply by one of these numbers, count its zeros and stick that many zeros on the end of your number. Drag the 0 bubbles into place.

levels.tip: 3 × 10 = 30. It's just 3 with a 0 on the end!
25 × 10 = 250. Even big numbers just get a 0 on the end!
